description: The bar chart illustrates two sets of data: Accuracy (%) and Token Count. The horizontal axis represents different methods, labeled as CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT. The vertical axis on the left measures accuracy in percentage, ranging from 70% to 100%, while the vertical axis on the right measures token count, ranging from 0 to 800. The accuracy data is represented by bars in red, orange, blue, and green, with the highest accuracy at 91.19% for CoT and the lowest at 80.89% for CoD. The token count data is represented by bars in the same colors, with the highest count at 676.85 for CCoT and the lowest at 354.46 for CoUT. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there are no bars that are visually emphasized.
